Find developer jobs that are remote, in Portuguese or English.
Find mid-level data engineering roles, titled in Portuguese or English.
Find junior roles open to remote work, in any language.
Find senior developer or software engineering roles, titled in either language.
Find open engineering positions (software engineering), in either language.
Find remote roles that involve data work.
Find junior developer roles, titled in Portuguese or English.
Find roles that can be done remotely.
Find engineering roles.
Find junior-level roles.
Find mid-level roles.
Find roles that involve Kubernetes.
Find postings that mention a start date. Does NOT want data/dados roles.
Find postings that offer parking for employees, or parking-related work. Does NOT want every job opening.
Find privacy / LGPD analyst roles. Does NOT want generic data engineering or data analyst roles.
Find civil engineering roles. Does NOT want software engineers or other engineering disciplines.
Find sales and customer roles for the mid-market segment. Does NOT want mid-level (pleno) developer roles.
